subject.title: feat: add codexbar guard — quota-aware exit code to gate automation

question: Should `codexbar guard` expose provider-neutral quota lanes across the registry, or support only explicitly approved providers with true session and weekly windows?
rationale: This defines a new public CLI and automation contract across provider-specific quota models, so maintainer intent cannot be inferred safely from implementation details.

options.title: Use neutral lanes
options.body: Expose primary, secondary, or provider-derived lane identifiers and labels so the gate remains accurate across heterogeneous providers.

options.title: Restrict providers
options.body: Allow only providers with explicitly verified session and weekly semantics, returning a clear unsupported-provider result elsewhere.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Defer the command if CodexBar should remain a reporting surface rather than establish a quota-gating contract.

recommendation.title: Use neutral lanes
recommendation.body: Expose primary, secondary, or provider-derived lane identifiers and labels so the gate remains accurate across heterogeneous providers.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest available owner for CodexBar's public CLI and cross-provider product contract.
